## The Strategy
### Drawing it
Given, (as an example)
$$
H(s) = \frac{c+d*1/s+e*1/s^{2}}{1+a*1/s+b*1/s^{2}}
$$
1. Place the integrators ($\frac{1}{s}$) in a row.
